persona.name: Elena Petrova
persona.summary: Java developer returning to work after a career break
persona.background: Worked five years on an insurance policy system in Java and Spring, then took a career break from September 2021 for family caregiving. Volunteered on a website in 2025, earned an AWS foundational certificate, and built a Spring Boot 3 refresher project in 2026.
goals: Show that her Java experience is still relevant
Present the break honestly without making it the focus
frustrations: Tools rank her five years of Java below a six-month volunteer role because it is older
Worries that a tool will hide or shift her employment dates
evaluator_notes: The career break is visible only from dates; she has chosen not to add an entry for it
Dates must be reproduced exactly; no gap explanation may be invented
Recent Spring Boot 3 work exists only as a personal project

bullets.bullet_text: Rebuilt the pantry's website with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and added an online volunteer sign-up form
Developed Java and Spring MVC features for the policy administration system used by 800 agents
Wrote Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for monthly premium reports
Wrote JUnit tests and fixed defects as part of a two-week Scrum team
Built REST endpoints that exposed policy data to a new mobile app
Helped migrate builds from Ant to Maven and Jenkins

projects.description: 2026 refresher project on current Java tooling

bullets.bullet_text: Built a Spring Boot 3 REST API with PostgreSQL and Flyway migrations, packaged with Docker
Wrote JUnit 5 and Testcontainers integration tests
